def test_csv_includes_memo(book):
    book.deposit("ALICE", "1.00", date(2024, 1, 2), memo="tip, cash")
    lines = to_csv(book.transactions).splitlines()
    assert lines[0] == "seq,account,date,kind,amount,memo"
    assert lines[2] == '2,ALICE,2024-01-02,deposit,1.00,"tip, cash"'

import json
from datetime import date

from ledger.export import to_json


def test_to_json_can_filter_by_account(book):
    book.deposit("BOB", "3.00", date(2024, 1, 2))
    data = json.loads(to_json(book.transactions, account="BOB"))
    assert [row["account"] for row in data] == ["BOB"]
